text:
zoe_cs: Quick askCustomer kickoff in AM. Need a 1-page "Lite Ops Checks" (copy/paste friendly) covering prefill, batching, KV cache, streaming, 72h risk signals, and three quick mitigation steps. Keep it non-technical for ops teams.

pat_se: I'll draft. Short bullets + three copyable snippets. No internal flags.

omar_sre: Include a tiny degraded flow: switch region -> reduce generation tokens -> enable compact fallback.

nina_support: I'll add top-4 FAQs (one line answers). Mostly seeing "token spike" and "stream stalls".

pat_se: Draft below: 
pat_se: "Lite Ops Checks (one page)
- Preflight: prefill ~10% users for 15min to seed cache; capture baseline tokens/day.
- Prefill (copy/paste): for i in $(seq 1 100); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\",\"max_tokens\":64,\"metadata\":{\"prefill\":true}}' & done; wait
- Batching: short prompts <80 tokens -> target_batch_size=20, max_wait_ms=25. Long outputs -> target_batch_size=4.
- KV cache: prefix_cache=true, ttl=300s interactive, 45s high-churn.
- Streaming: enable for outputs >512 tokens; keepalive_s=12; socket_timeout_ms=45000.
- 72h watchlist: P95 latency, tokens/day delta vs baseline, 4xx/5xx rate.
- Quick mitigations (order): 1) Route to alternate region with spare capacity. 2) Drop max_generation_tokens by 25% + halve batch size. 3) Flip to compact fallback model.
- What to send support: sample request JSON, route.name, account_id, prompt_hash, X-Request-ID.
- Escalation: if two watchlist signals occur in 72h, open cs:quick-review."

nina_support: FAQs: 1) Tokens spiked? -> Check for repeated prompts & long system instructions; enable client-side dedupe + prefill. 2) Streaming stalls? -> Increase keepalive and check proxies for buffering. 3) How to limit spend? -> daily token cap + per-minute limits and alert at 60%. 4) How to confirm warm pool? -> Compare median warm vs cold latencies; expect warm << cold.

lee_pm: Add one-liner for success metric: aim for prefix_cache_hit_rate > 40% after prefill.

ops_bot: ops_bot: Draft saved to /portal-drafts/cs/lite-ops-checks-v1 (preview link internal).

zoe_cs: Thanks team. I'll convert to PDF + HTML and share in kickoff deck. Owner: zoe_cs. Due: tomorrow 8am PT.
